name: My Army Simulator
desc:
✨ Welcome to My Army Simulator! This is a game where you build a team of police and take down the evil criminals!

🔥Unlock new weapons and gears to defeat criminals!🔥

😃Complete over 100 + Rainbow Stages🌈

👍 Every level has been tested and it is sure possible! 🔨

📝 Don't worry! your progress is saved automatically! 📝

🔔🔔🔔Remember to follow and like for UPDATES🔔🔔🔔

Join our group for in-game rewards!🎉
